scenario.summary: Cross-app regression for z10-28100 on Multistore13: admin unassigns the Custom Flat Rate shipping method from the Retail Customer profile and the registered user does not see it at checkout; admin assigns it again and the user sees it. A finally block restores the assignment. No order is placed.
steps: Admin (credentials from the environment): open the Retail Customer profile shipping, unassign shippingMethodName and check it is unassigned
Webstore: sign in with webUsername/webPassword, empty the cart, add sku at quantity 1, check out, click Ship Complete if shown
Shipping options render (count > 0) and the Custom Flat Rate label (lblShippingMethodFLAT) is absent
Admin: assign shippingMethodName to the Retail Customer profile and check it is assigned
Webstore: reach checkout shipping again; the Custom Flat Rate label is visible
Empty the cart; finally re-assign the method if it is not assigned
stateChanges: Admin unassigns and re-assigns the shipping method on the Retail Customer profile (shared store configuration; restored in finally)
The user's cart gets the product and is emptied at the end
assertions: Custom Flat Rate absent at checkout when unassigned, visible when assigned
evidence: Title matches the flow; Testim z10_28100 bug-repro, cross-app (admin + webstore)
